data.title: Prepare a prospect brief from CRM and documents
data.summary: Combine existing account context with public evidence while keeping facts and call hypotheses separate.

facts.text: Anthropic’s account-research demonstration uses Salesforce and Google Drive; it also offers a folder-based route before connectors are configured.

prerequisites: Access to Claude Cowork; check account, client and workspace availability.
Exact account identity, call goal and allowed source locations.
steps: Find the current account brief and confirm the exact company and reporting period.
Use existing authorized CRM/file connections or the supplied folder; do not create another connection by default.
Build a dated account fact table with source links and any contradictions.
Draft call questions and hypotheses separately from established facts.
Review private/public boundaries and save a brief without contacting the prospect or updating CRM records.
data.output: a cited account brief, call questions and open issues
validation: Keep it within the authorized audience and omit it from public-facing drafts.
limitations: Sintra-authored procedure based on provider documentation or demonstrations; no execution in the named app was performed.
Availability and results depend on your inputs, enabled tools and permissions; a suggested practice result is not a measured outcome.
data.prompt: Prepare a call brief for [exact account] and [decision] from [existing account plan, CRM scope and approved folder]. Reuse existing connections or supplied exports. Create a dated fact table with source links, contradictions and missing information. Separate facts from hypotheses and suggested questions. Keep private notes within the authorized audience. Save the brief without contacting the account or changing CRM records.
tips: Give the call decision and a short timebox.
Public filings and internal call notes have different audiences.

practice.task: A fictional CRM note says renewal is June; the signed contract says July.
practice.expected: The brief flags the conflict, cites both records and does not fabricate the renewal date.
